# minors

**minors  -- ideal generated by minors**

**Type:** [MethodFunctionWithOptions](../Type/MethodFunctionWithOptions.mdx)

## Description

 Minors are generated in the same order as that used by [subsets(ZZ](../Instance/subsets(ZZ.mdx) .When `n`  is negative the unit ideal is returned to preserve the expected ordering among the resulting ideals.

## Installed For

### minors([ZZ](../Type/ZZ.mdx), [Matrix](../Type/Matrix.mdx)) -> [Ideal](../Type/Ideal.mdx)

## Options

- [Strategy](../Option/Strategy.mdx) => null
- [Limit](../Option/Limit.mdx) => infinity
- [First](../Method/First.mdx) => null

## Examples

```macaulay2
minors(nM)
```

```macaulay2
minors(2M)

```

```text
ideal (- b*d + a*e - c*d + a*f - c*e + b*f)

Ideal of R
```

```macaulay2
minors(2M
```

```macaulay2
minors(1M)

```

```text
ideal (a d b e c f)

Ideal of R
```

```macaulay2
minors(0M)

```

```text
ideal 1

Ideal of R
```

```macaulay2
minors(-1M)

```

```text
ideal 1

Ideal of R
```

## Additional Information

- Inputs:
- `n` an [ integer](../Type/ZZ.mdx) order of the minor
- `M` a [ matrix](../Type/op_Coredollar_Matrix.mdx) a map between free modules
- [ Optional inputs](../Instance/using functions with optional inputs.mdx):
- `First```a [ list](../Type/op_Coredollar_List.mdx) default value null if given should be a list of two integer lists which will be the first minor computed
- `Limit```an [ integer](../Type/ZZ.mdx) default value infinity the maximum number of minors to find
- [](../Instance/minors(....mdx)```...` default value null choose between Bareiss Cofactor and Dynamic algorithms
- Outputs:
- an [ ideal](../Type/op_Coredollar_Ideal.mdx) the ideal generated by the `n` by `n` minors of the matrix `M`
